# NorseLift

> NorseLift is a free workout tracker built as a Progressive Web App (PWA). It helps lifters track workouts, build custom workouts and routines, monitor progress, and crush personal records — on any device, installed straight from the browser.

## Overview

NorseLift is a gym and strength training tracker designed for serious lifters who want a clean, focused tool without ads or clutter. It works on any device (phone, tablet, desktop) through the browser and can be installed to the home screen like a native app. It also works offline.

## Key Features

- **Custom workouts & routines**: Build your own workouts and combine them into a routine (Push/Pull/Legs, Upper/Lower, or custom). Free: up to 3 custom workouts and 1 scheduled routine
- **Workout logging**: Log sets, reps, and weight during your session with a clean interface
- **Rest timer**: Starts automatically when you complete a set (vibration on supported Android devices)
- **Progress dashboard**: Streak calendar, body weight, cardio and strength trend (free); Exercise Progression charts with next-session targets, per-muscle strength breakdown, weekly volume, monthly recap and cardio trend (Pro)
- **Personal records**: Automatic PR detection and a PR celebration after every workout (free); the full Personal Records list (Pro)
- **Routine scheduling & training blocks**: Schedule a routine across the week and label bulk/cut/maintain blocks (free); block-scoped stats and block history (Pro)
- **Exercise library**: 100+ built-in exercises, browse and search by muscle group
- **Body weight tracking**: Log body weight, see trends and charts over time
- **Workout sharing**: Generate branded share cards after completing a workout
- **Warm-up sets**: Mark sets as warm-up to exclude them from volume and PR calculations
- **Cloud sync**: Data syncs across all your devices
- **Offline support**: Works without an internet connection
- **PWA**: Install to your home screen or desktop straight from the browser

## Connect your AI (MCP), Pro — new in v1.0.0

NorseLift Pro users (paid, gifted or referral) can connect AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Claude, Grok and any other app that supports custom connectors via the Model Context Protocol (MCP).

- **MCP server URL**: https://app.norselift.com/mcp
- **Auth**: OAuth consent; you approve the connection on a NorseLift page. Manage or revoke connected apps in Settings.
- **What an assistant can do**: log and edit workouts, read workouts and training stats, list exercises, create routines and Library workouts, schedule routines, set the active routine, and delete/restore items (deletes ask for confirmation).

How to connect:
1. In NorseLift, open Settings → AI assistants and copy the MCP URL.
2. Claude: Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector → paste the URL → Add.
3. ChatGPT: Settings → Apps & Connectors → turn on Developer mode → Create → paste the URL.
4. Other MCP apps: add a custom connector / server URL and paste the URL.
5. Approve the connection on the NorseLift sign-in page.

Example: "Make me a 3-day aesthetic routine, Mon/Wed/Fri, and make it active" → the assistant calls create_routine, schedule_routine and set_active_routine.

## Pricing

- **Free tier**: Up to 3 custom workouts, 1 scheduled routine, full workout history (editing limited to the last 7 days), exercise library, smart suggestions, rest timer, PR celebrations, body weight, cardio, training blocks, cloud sync
- **Pro** includes Connect your AI (MCP) at no extra cost
- **Pro Monthly**: $4.99/month ($1.99 first month for new subscribers only, via the Newcomer offer)
- **Pro Quarterly**: $10.49/quarter ($3.49/month)
- **Pro Yearly**: $29.99/year ($2.49/month)

## Links

- Website: https://norselift.com
- App: https://app.norselift.com
- Upgrade to Pro: https://app.norselift.com/upgrade

## Technical Details

- Built with React, TypeScript, and Vite
- Firebase for authentication and cloud sync
- Stripe for subscription billing
- Hosted on Vercel
- Progressive Web App with service worker for offline use

## Target Audience

NorseLift is for gym-goers and strength athletes who want a simple, focused workout tracker. It's especially suited for people who follow structured routines (like PPL, Upper/Lower, or custom splits) and want to track their progress over time without the bloat of larger fitness apps.

## Company

NorseLift is an independent product built in Norway.
